title: Principal Handoff: a protocol for items only the principal can settle (agent-ops-specs)
description: Open, implementation-neutral specifications for operating AI agents alongside the person or organisation they act for. This archive contains Principal Handoff, a draft protocol family for work and choices that only the principal may settle and that outlive every agent session: a core model with a need register owned by the requester and a settlement register owned by the principal side, claims that change nothing, and settlements that record the decider and an authority kind (principal, confirmed, delegated, attested); and two extensions, Acts (with a Markdown binding for a project's state document) and Decisions. It includes JSON Schemas, conformance suites and a standard-library Python reference implementation. Website: https://imaknas.github.io/agent-ops-specs/. Licensed under Apache-2.0.
